```{r Read and Merge TimeSeries Expression Data}
library(data.table)

# Initialize list to store results
Species_TimeSeries_Expression <- list()

# Loop through each element in Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants
for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  element <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]]

  # Extract species info
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))

  # Find all relevant files
  species_files <- list.files(
    path = R_Data,
    pattern = paste0("^", species_prefix, ".*TimeSeries_([0-9]+).*"),
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(species_files) == 0) next  # Skip if no matching files found

  # Read and process all files efficiently with data.table
  file_dt_list <- lapply(species_files, function(f) {
    tryCatch({
      dt <- fread(f, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
      # Clean up header
      setnames(dt, gsub("#", "", names(dt)))

      # Ensure we map the first two columns to gene_id and Expression_value
      if (ncol(dt) < 2) stop("file has fewer than 2 columns: ", f)
      setnames(dt, old = names(dt)[1:2], new = c("gene_id", "Expression_value"))

      # Coerce expression to numeric (safely)
      dt[, Expression_value := as.numeric(Expression_value)]

      # Compute log2(expression + 1)
      dt[, log2_Expression_Plus_One := log2(Expression_value + .5)]
      #dt[, log2_Expression_Plus_One := (Expression_value + 1)]

      # Extract timepoint number from filename
      tp <- sub(".*TimeSeries_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", basename(f))
      dt[, time_point := tp]

      # Keep only required columns
      #dt[, .(gene_id, time_point, log2_Expression_Plus_One)]
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Failed reading ", f, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
  })

  # Drop any NULL results from failed reads
  file_dt_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), file_dt_list)
  if (length(file_dt_list) == 0) next

  # Combine all timepoints into one long data.table
  combined_long <- rbindlist(file_dt_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  # If there are duplicated (gene_id, time_point) pairs, aggregate (mean) them:
  # (change mean to sum/median/first if you prefer)
  if (any(duplicated(combined_long[, .(gene_id, time_point)]))) {
    combined_long <- combined_long[, .(log2_Expression_Plus_One = mean(log2_Expression_Plus_One, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                   by = .(gene_id, time_point)]
  }

  # Pivot wider — use time_point as the column variable and log2_Expression_Plus_One as the values
  merged_expression_wide <- dcast(
    combined_long,
    gene_id ~ time_point,
    value.var = "log2_Expression_Plus_One",
    fun.aggregate = mean,
    fill = NA
  )

  # Rename timepoint columns to include the prefix
  time_cols <- setdiff(names(merged_expression_wide), "gene_id")
  setnames(merged_expression_wide, old = time_cols, new = paste0("log2_Expression_Plus_One", time_cols))

  # Merge expression matrix into the Annotated VCF (ensure both are data.tables)
  element_dt <- as.data.table(element)
  element_expression <- merge(
    element_dt,
    merged_expression_wide,
    by.x = "GENE_ID",
    by.y = "gene_id",
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  # Save the updated element back into the list
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]] <- element_expression

  # Store the raw list of data.tables if you need them later
  Species_TimeSeries_Expression[[species_name]] <- file_dt_list
}
```

```{r Expression Versus Mutation Rate Associations}
# 1 Mutation Rate vs Expression Associations: Linear and Non-Linear

# Initialize master lists
Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests <- list()
Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests  <- list()

# Loop through each element in Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants
for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {
  
  # Extract dataframe for this species
  df <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]]
  
  # --- Extract species name from element_name ---
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))
  
  # Ensure sublists exist for this species
  Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]] <- list()
  Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[species_name]]  <- list()
  
  # Identify all timepoint expression columns
  expr_cols <- grep("^log2_Expression_Plus_One", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  
  # Loop through each timepoint expression column
  for (expr_col in expr_cols) {
    
    # Extract timepoint label from column name
    time_label <- sub("log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", expr_col)
    plot_tag   <- paste0(species_name, "_Time_", time_label)
    
    # --- Correlations ---
    spearman_test <- cor.test(df[[expr_col]], df[["UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"]], method = "spearman")
    pearson_test  <- cor.test(df[[expr_col]], df[["UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"]], method = "pearson")
    
    # Save results into species-specific sublists
    Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species_name]][[time_label]] <- spearman_test
    Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Pearson_Tests[[species_name]][[time_label]]  <- pearson_test
    
    # --- Plot 1: linear regression scatter ---
    plotting_data <- df[is.na(df[[expr_col]]) == FALSE]
    p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = plotting_data,
          aes(x = plotting_data[[expr_col]], 
              y = plotting_data[["UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"]])) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
      labs(
        title = paste(species_name, "\n", time_label, "min"),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Spearman: p=", signif(spearman_test$p.value, 4),
          " (ρ=", signif(spearman_test$estimate, 3), "); ",
          "Pearson: p=", signif(pearson_test$p.value, 4),
          " (r=", signif(pearson_test$estimate, 3), ")"
        ),
        caption = "Linear regression overlay"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10)
    
    # --- Save the plot ---
    ggsave(
      p1,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/6_Mutation_and_TimeSeries_Expression_Association_Plots/",
        species_prefix, "/",
        plot_tag, "_Linear_Association_Plot.png"
      ),
      width = 5,
      height = 4,
      dpi = 300,
      create.dir = TRUE
    )
    
  } # end for expr_col
  
} # end for element_name
```

```{r TimeSeries Summary Plots}
# Collapse nested list of correlation test objects into one dataframe
library(dplyr)

Spearman_summary <- lapply(names(Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests), function(species) {
  species_list <- Species_TimeSeries_Expression_MutationRate_Spearman_Tests[[species]]
  
  # Extract timepoint, estimate, and p.value from each correlation test
  data.frame(
    species    = species,
    timepoint  = names(species_list),
    coefficient = sapply(species_list, function(x) unname(x$estimate)),
    p_value     = sapply(species_list, function(x) x$p.value),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Sort by species and timepoint if desired
Spearman_summary <- Spearman_summary %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>%
  arrange(species, timepoint)

# Set minimum p Value for Plotting Purposes
Spearman_summary <- Spearman_summary %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = ifelse(p_value < 1e-300, 1e-300, p_value),  # set floor
    neglog10p = -log10(p_value)
  )

Spearman_summary$species <- factor(Spearman_summary$species,
                                   levels = c("Dmelanogaster","Celegans","Ppacificus"))


# Plot it
test <- 
  ggplot(data = Spearman_summary,
         aes(x = timepoint, y = coefficient)) + 
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(~species, scales = "free")


library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

testgpt <-
ggplot(subset(Spearman_summary, species %ni% "Ppacificus"), aes(x = timepoint, y = coefficient)) +
  
  # faint background line showing trend
  geom_line(aes(group = species), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # main points, scaled by significance, colored by correlation, with black borders
  geom_point(
    aes(size = -log10(p_value), fill = coefficient),
    shape = 21,              # allows fill + border
    color = "black",         # border color
    stroke = 0.4,            # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # smooth curve
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # facet by species (keep names, remove grey box)
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free_x") +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "green", high = "red") +
    theme_bw() +
  theme(# Transparent backgrounds
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
          legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
          # Keep grid lines visible and black
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.2),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 6, colour = "white", hjust = .5),
          text = element_text(color = "white"),
          axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
          legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
          legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, color = "white", hjust = .5, face = "italic"),
          strip.text = element_text(color = "white")) +
          scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  # labels
  labs(
    x = "Embryonic Timepoint (Minutes [Right] and Hours [Left])",
    y = "Spearman Correlation Coefficient (ρ)",
    fill  = "Correlation (ρ)",
    size  = expression(-log[10](p)),
    title = "Gene Mutation Rate vs. Expression Correlation Across Development",
    subtitle = "Each Point Represents a Spearman Correlation per Timepoint per Species",
    caption = "Dashed Line = LOESS Smooth; Point Size ∝ Significance (p-value)"
  ) + theme(panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"))

ggsave(
      testgpt,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/6_Mutation_and_TimeSeries_Expression_Association_Plots/",
        "Pan_Species_MutationRate_vs_Expression_Coefficients_Across_Development.png"
      ),
      width = 8,
      height = 4,
      dpi = 2000,
      create.dir = TRUE
    )
```

```{r Clustering Heatmaps and TimeSeries of Developmental Expression }
options(bitmapType = "cairo")

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
gc()

species_k <- c(
  "Celegans" = 7,
  "Ppacificus" = 6,
  "Dmelanogaster" = 8
)

default_k <- 6L

max_k <- max(c(default_k, unname(species_k)), na.rm = TRUE)
cluster_palette_all <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(max_k, palette = "Purple-Green"),
  as.character(seq_len(max_k))
)

out_dir <- file.path(R_Data, "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cluster_results <- list()

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  df <- as.data.frame(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]])

  expr_cols <- grep("^log2_Expression_Plus_One[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(expr_cols) == 0) next

  timepoints <- as.numeric(sub("^log2_Expression_Plus_One", "", expr_cols))
  ord <- order(timepoints)
  expr_cols <- expr_cols[ord]
  timepoints <- timepoints[ord]

  keep_cols <- c("GENE_ID", "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP", "dNdS", expr_cols)
  keep_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, names(df))

  expression_and_meta <- df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% unique()
  expression_and_meta <- expression_and_meta[
    complete.cases(expression_and_meta[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE]),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(expression_and_meta) < 3) next

  expr_mat <- as.matrix(expression_and_meta[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

  row_id <- make.unique(as.character(expression_and_meta$GENE_ID))

  row_scaled_expression <- t(scale(t(expr_mat)))
  row_scaled_expression[row_scaled_expression > 4] <- 4
  row_scaled_expression[row_scaled_expression < -4] <- -4

  keep <- apply(row_scaled_expression, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))
  row_scaled_expression <- row_scaled_expression[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  expression_and_meta <- expression_and_meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  row_id <- row_id[keep]
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(row_scaled_expression) < 3) next

  colnames(row_scaled_expression) <- as.character(timepoints)
  rownames(row_scaled_expression) <- row_id
  expression_and_meta$row_id <- row_id

  if (species_name %in% names(species_k)) {
    k_use <- species_k[[species_name]]
  } else {
    k_use <- default_k
  }

  k_use <- max(2, min(k_use, nrow(row_scaled_expression) - 1))

  heatmap_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2,0,2), c("#5A189A","white","#FF9100"))

  set.seed(69)

  ht <- Heatmap(
    row_scaled_expression,
    col = heatmap_col_fun,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_km = k_use,
    row_km_repeats = 500,
    show_row_names = FALSE
  )

  png(file.path(out_dir, paste0("Heatmap_", species_name, ".png")),
      width = 3000, height = 5000, res = 900, type = "cairo-png")
  ht_drawn <- draw(ht)
  dev.off()

  cluster_list <- row_order(ht_drawn)

  cluster_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_list), function(i) {
    data.frame(
      row_id = rownames(row_scaled_expression)[cluster_list[[i]]],
      cluster = factor(i)
    )
  }))

  clustered_df <- merge(expression_and_meta, cluster_df, by = "row_id")

  # =========================
  # MUTATION RATE BOXPLOT
  # =========================
  if ("UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP" %in% names(clustered_df)) {

    p_mut <- ggplot(clustered_df,
                    aes(x = fct_reorder(cluster, UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, median),
                        y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
                        fill = cluster)) +
      geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0(species_name, " Mutation Rate by Cluster"))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("MutationRate_", species_name, ".png")),
           p_mut, width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 900)
  }

  # =========================
  # dNdS BOXPLOT (NEW)
  # =========================
  if ("dNdS" %in% names(clustered_df)) {

    dnds_df <- clustered_df[!is.na(clustered_df$dNdS), ]

    if (nrow(dnds_df) > 0 && length(unique(dnds_df$cluster)) > 1) {

      p_dnds <- ggplot(dnds_df,
                       aes(x = fct_reorder(cluster, dNdS, median),
                           y = dNdS,
                           fill = cluster)) +
        geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(title = paste0(species_name, " dNdS by Cluster"))

      ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("dNdS_", species_name, ".png")),
             p_dnds, width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 900)
    }
  }

  cluster_results[[species_name]] <- clustered_df
  
  # ============================================================
# GO OVER-REPRESENTATION ENRICHMENT FOR K-MEANS CLUSTERS
# (FIXED VERSION — INSIDE LOOP)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Ce.eg.db)
  library(org.Dm.eg.db)
})

if (species_name %in% c("Celegans", "Dmelanogaster")) {

  if (species_name == "Celegans") {
    orgdb <- org.Ce.eg.db
    keytype_used <- "WORMBASE"
    species_tag <- "Celegans"
  } else {
    orgdb <- org.Dm.eg.db
    keytype_used <- "FLYBASE"
    species_tag <- "Dmelanogaster"
  }

  message("==== Running enrichment for ", element_name, " ====")

  species_out_dir <- file.path(
    R_Data,
    "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/Cluster_GO_Enrichment",
    species_tag
  )
  dir.create(species_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  for (cl in sort(unique(na.omit(clustered_df$cluster)))) {

    genes <- unique(clustered_df$GENE_ID[clustered_df$cluster == cl])

    message("Cluster ", cl, " genes: ", length(genes))

    if (length(genes) < 5) next

    ego <- tryCatch(
      enrichGO(
        gene = genes,
        OrgDb = orgdb,
        keyType = keytype_used,
        ont = "BP",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff = 1,
        qvalueCutoff = 1,
        readable = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("enrichGO failed for cluster ", cl)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (is.null(ego)) next

    ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)

    message("Cluster ", cl, " GO terms: ", nrow(ego_df))

    if (nrow(ego_df) == 0) next

    # SAVE TABLE
    write.table(
      ego_df,
      file = file.path(
        species_out_dir,
        paste0(element_name, "_Cluster_", cl, "_GO.tsv")
      ),
      sep = "\t",
      row.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE
    )

    # PLOT
    plot_df <- ego_df %>%
      arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      slice_head(n = min(15, nrow(.))) %>%
      mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))

    p <- ggplot(plot_df,
                aes(x = Description,
                    y = -log10(p.adjust),
                    fill = Count)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#003300", high = "orange") +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste0(species_tag, " Cluster ", cl),
        y = "-log10(adj p)",
        x = NULL
      )

    ggsave(
      file.path(
        species_out_dir,
        paste0(element_name, "_Cluster_", cl, "_GO.png")
      ),
      p,
      width = 7,
      height = 5,
      dpi = 600
    )
  }
}
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Ce.eg.db)
  library(org.Dm.eg.db)
  library(ggplot2)
})

if (species_name %in% c("Celegans", "Dmelanogaster")) {

  # ----------------------------
  # Species setup (same as your working script)
  # ----------------------------
  if (species_name == "Celegans") {
    orgdb <- org.Ce.eg.db
    keytype_used <- "WORMBASE"
    species_tag <- "Celegans"
  } else {
    orgdb <- org.Dm.eg.db
    keytype_used <- "FLYBASE"
    species_tag <- "Dmelanogaster"
  }

  message("Running cluster enrichment for: ", element_name)

  species_out_dir <- file.path(
    R_Data,
    "Plots/7_Developmental_TimeSeries_Clustering/Cluster_GO_Enrichment",
    species_tag
  )
  dir.create(species_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # ----------------------------
  # Loop over clusters
  # ----------------------------
  for (cl in sort(unique(na.omit(clustered_df$cluster)))) {

    df_cl <- clustered_df %>%
      filter(cluster == cl) %>%
      distinct(GENE_ID)

    genes <- df_cl$GENE_ID

    if (length(genes) < 10) next

    message("Cluster ", cl, " genes: ", length(genes))

    # ----------------------------
    # Over-representation (NOT GSEA)
    # ----------------------------
    enrich_res <- tryCatch(
      enrichGO(
        gene = genes,
        OrgDb = orgdb,
        keyType = keytype_used,
        ont = "BP",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff = 1,
        qvalueCutoff = 1,
        readable = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("enrichGO failed for cluster ", cl)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (is.null(enrich_res)) next

    enrich_df <- as.data.frame(enrich_res)
    if (nrow(enrich_df) == 0) next

    # Save table
    write.table(
      enrich_df,
      file = file.path(
        species_out_dir,
        paste0(element_name, "_Cluster_", cl, "_GO.tsv")
      ),
      sep = "\t",
      row.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE
    )

    # ----------------------------
    # PLOT (same style as your script)
    # ----------------------------
    plot_df <- enrich_df %>%
      arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      slice_head(n = 15) %>%
      mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))

    p_bar <- ggplot(plot_df,
                    aes(x = Description,
                        y = -log10(p.adjust),
                        fill = Count)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#003300", high = "orange") +
      labs(
        title = paste0(species_tag, " Cluster ", cl, " GO enrichment"),
        x = NULL,
        y = "-log10(adj p-value)"
      ) +
      theme_bw()

    ggsave(
      plot = p_bar,
      filename = file.path(
        species_out_dir,
        paste0(element_name, "_Cluster_", cl, "_GO_barplot.png")
      ),
      width = 7,
      height = 5,
      dpi = 800,
      bg = "transparent"
    )
  }
}
```
